title: 15Sept-Sponsored 150 pieces of Fabric for Kshamata
summary: Kshamata equips women survivors of gender-based violence by counselling, upskilling and enabling employment opportunities to make them self-reliant.
description:
Kshamata equips women survivors of gender-based violence by counselling, upskilling and enabling employment opportunities to make them self-reliant. They help these women, who are survivors of human trafficking, by imparting vocational oriented life skills, functional literacy, vocational training, work readiness to get employment. They also impart confidence in these girls, give them hope to enable them to achieve their goals.
On 15th September, 150 pieces of cotton fabric was sponsored by Rtn Karishma Parekh via the Club for Kshamata for their tailoring unit.
The value of 150 pieces of cotton fabric is Rs 3000 /-
